name: China HK Power Smart Energy Group Limited
summary: China HK Power Smart Energy Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the sales and distribution of natural gas (NG), liquefied natural gas (LNG), and pipeline natural gas (PNG) in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It operates through three segments: NG Business, New Energy Business, and Financial Services. The company is involved in the wholesale of LNG and PNG; point-to-point supply of LNG through industrial gasification stations, dewar bottle filling stations and automobile gas stations, and regional gas pipeline networks; automobile gas stations; LNG pipeline network; and provision of LNG logistic services.
